text:
Maya: FYI I've dropped the first-pass PRD for observability retention & UX — https://redwood.atlassian.com/prd/OBS-RETENTION-V1 :eyes:
Maya: Need help tightening acceptance criteria and surfacing edge cases before we ship the doc to legal + infra next week
Sam: skimmed it. main constraint: backend storage cost grows non-linearly with trace retention. we should be explicit about sample vs full retention and the tradeoffs
Jin: UX q — are we exposing retention per-organization or per-dashboard? this changes the flow a lot. per-org is simpler but less flexible for product teams
Maya: good call. customer asks were for per-project retention + org default. proposal in PRD is org default + per-project override (dropdown on project settings)
Oliver: alert: exporting full traces for >30d will hit S3 budget we didn't account for. we need hard caps or async exports to avoid throttles
Eva: several enterprise customers explicitly asked for legal-hold and manual deletion controls. include an acceptance criterion for "admin-initiated legal hold prevents auto-deletion"
Sam: acceptance idea: for each tier (7/30/90/365) define: 1) query SLA (99th p95 latency), 2) max export window, 3) storage cap per-tenant. if exceeded, system auto-samples older traces
Maya: draft acceptance criteria (please comment):
- Retention tiers available: 7d, 30d, 90d, 365d
- Admin can set org default; project-level override with no more than org max
- Legal-hold flag prevents deletion for selected projects for up to X years and shows clear audit trail
- Query latency for dashboard rollups: median < 200ms, p95 < 1s for typical query (30d window, 1m rollups)
- Export API supports async bulk export; export jobs honor tenant storage caps and show progress in UI
Jin: UX edge cases: what if a project override is shorter than org default? UI should show warning and make override explicit. also we need a migration path for existing projects (show current retention -> recommend match org default)
Oliver: edge-case: partial traces spanning retention boundary. decision: when a trace contains spans older than retention cutoff, drop older spans but keep trace skeleton with note "incomplete". this preserves metrics but may confuse debugging
Sam: can we add an opt-in for "preserve trace continuity" that pins full traces but counts against a special quota? might satisfy debugging customers without global cost blowup
Eva: compliance edge-case: data deletion requests (GDPR) should be honored across backups & exports. acceptance criterion: deletion request triggers cascade and shows status in audit log within 24h
Maya: draft migration plan in PRD: step 1) apply org default to projects without explicit setting with 14 day notice, step 2) enable per-project overrides in beta for 30 days behind feature flag, step 3) roll to GA after metrics look good
Sam: telemetry we need in canary: storage per-tenant, percent of projects with overrides, avg query latency by retention tier, sample rate for old traces
Jin: UI snippets: small dropdown on project settings labeled "Data retention" with inline help: "Shorter retention reduces cost and storage. Admins can enforce a max retention." also add an "impact" popover that shows monthly cost delta estimate using current usage patterns
Maya: can someone add a short policy snippet for the PRD that developers can copy into infra tickets? something like:
```
RetentionPolicy: 
  tiers: [7, 30, 90, 365]
  orgDefault: 30
  projectOverride: true
  legalHold: true
  preserveContinuityOptIn: false
  softDeleteWindow: 7  # soft delete grace before purge
```
Sam: I'll add that to the infra ticket. question about softDeleteWindow — needs to be per-tenant when legal-hold is pending
Oliver: also add a hard throttle: if tenant storage > 150% of committed cap, throttle exports and surface a billing alert in console + email to billing contact
Eva: customer ask: CSV export of retention policy per org for audits. add acceptance: exportable policy CSV + signed audit timestamps for enterprise customers
Maya: outstanding decisions for next sync: (1) preserve continuity opt-in quota mechanics, (2) exact SLA numbers for p95 queries by tier, (3) legal-hold retention limits and audit format
Jin: design will mock the project-setting dropdown + the rollout notification modal. ETA: EOD Thursday
Sam: infra needs API design for overrides + enforcement. I'll post a short API sketch in the PRD comments by tomorrow
Oliver: can we schedule a 30m decision call Friday to lock the three outstanding items? I'll bring SRE cost estimates and throttling thresholds
Maya: yes please — Fri 10am PT works for me. @Oliver please invite legal and billing for the audit + legal-hold bits
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting: Observability Retention Decisions — Fri 10:00 PT — attendees: Maya, Sam, Jin, Oliver, Eva, Legal, Billing
Maya: thanks all. please add any quick notes as replies. I'll iterate the acceptance criteria and push an updated PRD by tomorrow morning :+1:
Sam: noted, will add API sketch
Jin: will upload mocks
Oliver: prepping cost numbers
Eva: will compile customer asks and example legal-hold wording
Maya: end-of-thread summary will go in PRD. closing for now :wave:
